what: calibration and operating point of the deployed classifier on field photos (fruit on the tree); nothing here was measured on a belt

data.dataset: cashew_v3 crops: Ghana photos and the second Uganda label batch (field photos)
data.split: by source photo; no photo in two splits

near_copies_between_training_and_test.what: for every test crop, the smallest Hamming distance between its 64-bit difference hash and the hash of any training crop; a small distance means an almost identical picture
near_copies_between_training_and_test.not_covered: the same fruit photographed from another position or distance is not an almost identical picture and is not caught by this check; the photos carry no position data to test it

calibration.method: temperature scaling: one number fitted on the validation crops by minimum negative log-likelihood; the test crops are only used to report

operating_point.rule: answer rotten only when the calibrated probability of rotten reaches the cut; otherwise answer the more probable of the other two classes
operating_point.limit: rotten fruit called good must stay at or below 5%
operating_point.chosen_on: validation: the highest cut whose share of rotten fruit called good stays within the limit
